title: Writing Numbers 0 to 20: Match Numbers to Groups
seo_title: Kindergarten Writing Numbers 0-20 Worksheets: Number Names and Zero
standard_text: Write numbers from 0 to 20. Represent a number of objects with a written numeral 0–20 (with 0 representing a count of no objects).
meta_desc: Free kindergarten number writing worksheets: match groups of objects to the numbers 0 to 20, learn that 0 means none, read the number names zero to twenty, and write teen numbers the right way (14, not 41). 100 picture questions with an answer key.
key_big: Count the group, then write the number. Zero (0) means none.
key_sub: In teen numbers the 1 comes first: fourteen is 10 and 4, written 14.
body_html:
A number tells how many

Count the things. Then write the number.

Zero means none

When there is nothing, the number is 0.

Numbers 0 to 20

NumberNameNumberName
0zero11eleven
1one12twelve
2two13thirteen
3three14fourteen
4four15fifteen
5five16sixteen
6six17seventeen
7seven18eighteen
8eight19nineteen
9nine20twenty
10ten

Teen numbers: the 1 comes first

Fourteen is 10 and 4. We say the 4 first, but we write the 1 first: 14.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do
Writing 41 for fourteenWrite the 1 first: 14
Writing 104 for fourteen (10 and 4)Teen numbers have only 2 digits: 14
Writing 1 for noneNone is 0
Writing 2 for twentyTwenty is 2 tens: 20

faq.q: Which numbers should a kindergartner write?
faq.a: By the end of kindergarten, children write the numbers 0 to 20. They also write a number to show how many things are in a group, and use 0 when there are none.

faq.q: Why does my child write 41 instead of 14?
faq.a: We say 'four-teen', so the 4 comes first in speech. Show 14 as a full ten-frame and 4 more: the 1 stands for the ten, so it comes first.

faq.q: My child writes some numbers backward, like a backward 3. Is that a problem?
faq.a: It is very common at age 5 and 6. Give a model to copy, trace numbers in sand or with a finger, and say how the stroke goes. Most children stop by age 7.

faq.q: Why is zero hard for young children?
faq.a: Zero is the number for nothing, so there is nothing to count. Use an empty plate or an empty ten-frame and ask 'How many?' to show that the answer is 0.
